cast.characterName: コニー・イル・リクール
cast.originalCharacterName: コニー・イル・リクール

segments.text: Part, along with her friend Shela, of the 2-women crew of a small merchant steam-powered airship known as the Ulumensh. She's a trader, member of the 6th class frontier city of Dylas-Leen's Air Guild.
With the aid of her airship she buys, sells, exchange and deliver all sort of stuff between various neighboring locations.
Orphan, still emotionally tied to her former orphanage, so much to donate most of her earnings to it.
This, until the day she decides to save a mysterious green haired girl from the Empire's Army...
ライアーソフト第１７弾「蒼天のセレナリア」の主人公。
飛空艇ウルメンシュを操る、空の何でも屋。
義理堅く情に厚い。幾多のトラブルに巻き込まれながらも、力強く進んでいく。
本編主人公の一人。
飛空挺「ウルメンシュ」を駆って、相棒のシェラと空の「なんでも屋」を営む少女。元孤児。
明朗快活で女の子らしいしたたかさと、腹黒さを併せ持つ。
飛行艇の借金返済、整備費、修理費、孤児院への仕送りなどで常に貧乏。仕事は選ばないが、あくどい仕事はしない主義。
無限に広がる世界を飛び回り、まだ見ぬ世界の風景や人々との出会いを夢見ている。
基本的に理性で動くことを信条としているが、キレると事態が収拾するまで一直線に突っ走り続ける。
驾驶飞空艇『ウルメンシュ』、做着天空万用店的少女。原来是孤儿。
明亮快活。拥有少女的坚强与坏嘴巴。
因为飞空艇的还贷、整备费、修理费、孤儿院的资助，一直都很贫困。虽然不能随意选择工作，但不做违心事是她的信条。
梦想是踏进无限广阔的世界，遇见各种各样的人和景色。
Orphan of mysterious origins, Connie took her in as a child and taught her all she knew about airships, she has been with her since.
Her past is mostly unknown, but her overall appearance and capabilities makes it clear that she's a member of the heavily persecuted Pucelle specie.
Her excellent eyesight and her astounding ability in messing with machines make her an irreplaceable member of the Urmensch's crew.
She's actually princess Shela Rom, descendant princess tied by blood to the first emperor.
本編主人公の一人。
コニーのパートナー。猫目種族であるプーセル人の少女。
底抜けに明るく元気。精神年齢が低ければ、自主的な社会性も低い。
しかしバカではなく、与えられた仕事はきっちりこなし、以外に優秀。
惚れっぽい。子供っぽい性格からあまりそう見られないが、性にも奔放でエッチ。
トラブルメーカーになりがちだが、真剣になればそこそこ役立つ。
与コニー共同驾驶飞空艇『ウルメンシュ』的、细身小个子少女。
猫目的种族、プセール人。比コニー更要天真和明快。
精神年龄低，依靠着コニー。
对男性相当倾心。用充满爱娇的行动吸引男性。在性方面相当奔放，但因为她平时小孩子般的言行，让别人总是当她是傻瓜。
虽然经常制造麻烦，实际上是个认真做就会做得很好的女孩子。
A strange girl with green eyes and hair appeared out of nowhere.
She's carrying a certain green book, a book that prime minister "De Maxim" is determined to obtain at all costs.
未踏大陸西端の森林秘境に住む、樹木種の娘。
彼女との出会いが、コニーたちを冒険の旅へと誘う。
マタイオスの部下。秘書的な役割をこなしている。
口数少なく、喋るときは重くきつい。
帝国の大貴族であるマタイオスに対してもそうだが、誰に対しても物怖じしない。
シェラポンダンス野生種の娘。
樹木種と違って温厚ではなく、野性的で、攻撃的。
縄張りへ入ってきたコニーたちを敵と見なし、襲いかかってくる。

cast.characterName: マタイオス・ノン・デュ
cast.originalCharacterName: マタイオス・ノン・デュ

segments.text: 帝国貴族にして、帝国軍第三飛空艦隊提督。
プライドは高いが、他の貴族と違って高圧的ではない。非常に優雅な印象を与える美青年。
理想主義者を嫌うと嘯（うそぶ）くが、実は彼自身も理想主義。
巨大要塞を操る、戦術の天才。
帝国贵族兼帝国军第３飞空舰队提督。高傲的帅哥。
象征着优雅的貴族社会『帝国』的男人。
操纵着巨大要塞的、战术的天才。

cast.characterName: オーガスタ・エイダ・バイロン
cast.originalCharacterName: オーガスタ・エイダ・バイロン

segments.text: The "Engine Queen", 3rd of the Ten Scholars, an incredible genius in the "Calculation Engines" field.
Once a countess, she lost her noble title by divorce.
She initially helps the Ulumensh's crew infiltrating the floating city of Serranian, but...
帝国発展に貢献する様々な発明をおこなった、機関科学者、数学者。
若年でありながら、蒸気王・バベッジの再来と噂される頭脳を持つ天才。
The "princess of the tower" of the Secret Imperial Floating City of Serranian.
A mysterious humanoid creature with the ability of purifying the waters from all sorts of pollution.
Imprisoned by the empire to create the secret (and only) "blu skyed" city of the known world.

cast.characterName: レヴィ・マウア・ジェラード・カサス
cast.originalCharacterName: レヴィ・マウア・ジェラード・カサス

segments.text: Las Casas's grandson, a very young Dylas-Leen's Air Guild mechanic, so hardworking and brilliant to became a Scholar at a very young age.
He has a crush on Shella.
Leader of the Dylas-Leen's Air Guild.
He entrusted the Ulumensh to Connie and does everything he can to protect the guild's members.
He seems to have ties with many of the great scholars of the empire.
He's the son of the 8th of the Ten Peerless Scholars, Las Casas "The Priest"
Old prime minister of the empire, years of exposure to pollution compromised his health so much that he's not able to survive anymore whitout his advanced respiratory assist equipment.
Connie and Shella's animal companion.
It can demonstrate fairly high intelligence at times, despite being completely incapable of speech.

cast.characterName: チャールズ・バべッジ
cast.originalCharacterName: チャールズ・バべッジ

segments.text: The 296th Babbage Machine, a steel giant, the "King of All-Crushing Steel".
A giant machine made to defend the blue sky from the "known world" menaces.
The "Steam King" Charles Babbage implanted his own entire mind on its circuitry before dying.
As a human he was part of the very first expedition that led to the discover of planet Kadath along with Randolph Carter (the Grand Librarian) and Laura Nadelmann (the Expedition Princess).
He proved to be crucial for the development of advanced steam technology, the current steam civilization wouldn't have been possible without him.
